Welcome to the Vampire Life Wiki
The community guide to the Roblox survival RPG by dutdk. Disputed claims are marked with ⚠️, and code checks are date-stamped — if sources disagree, we say so.
== Featured: Original Vampire == [[File:Original-Vampire-spotlight.png|thumb|300px|The Original Vampire — top of the food chain.]] The top of the food chain — and the only path you can't grind your way into. The '''[[Original Vampire]]''' comes only from the Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) gamepass, sunlight damages but can't kill it, and only a White Oak Stake can finish it. == Characters == File:Human-model-Maxo.png|[[Human]] File:Vampire-model-Maxo.png|[[Vampire]] File:Original-Vampire-model-Maxo.png|[[Original Vampire]] File:Witch-model-Maxo.png|[[Witch]] File:Werewolf-full-wolf-mode-mako.png|[[Werewolf]] File:Original-Hybrid-model.png|[[Original Hybrid]] ''Human, Vampire, Original Vampire, and Witch models provided by Maxo. Werewolf slide image provided by mako. Hybrid gallery slot pending.'' == Did You Know? == * Original Vampire is not a spawn choice – it comes from a gamepass. * The only way to kill an Original Vampire is a White Oak Stake. * Original Hybrid takes level 5,000, a level 3,000+ transforming player, and the Original Vampire gamepass at a 0.5% chance (also stated as 0.1%; [[Sources#Discord confirmation|source]]). == Wiki Stats == This wiki currently has {{NUMBEROFARTICLES}} articles and {{NUMBEROFFILES}} files — and it's still growing. == Join the Community == Chat with other players and the wiki team on the game's Discord: [https://discord.com/invite/TUSfpjQaCG Join the Vampire Life Discord] == Start Here == * [[Beginner Guide]] — first spawn, leveling, turning, sunlight, death * [[Codes]] — active, disputed, and expired codes == Mechanics == * Aging & Levels | Feeding & Desiccation | Sunlight & Protection | Death | Turning == Items & Quests == * [[Items & Merchants]] | [[Quests & Bounties]] | [[Controls]] | [[Game Passes]]
